subject: English Language

questions.prompt: What does for the time being mean? (a at the moment, b at the same time, c at the beginning, d in present, e sometimes)
steps: The phrase means for now.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What does the land loses its temperature mean? (a gets high temperature, b does not change, c cools, d was cool, e becomes)
steps: Losing temperature means cooling; this vocabulary item is answerable without the absent listening script.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What does gradually mean? (a normal, b usual, c quickly, d slowly, e as usual)
steps: Gradually describes a change in small stages.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Give the opposite of appear. (a disappear, b happen, c slow, d highly, e quickly)
steps: Disappear means stop being visible.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Choose the best listening-passage title. (a temperature, b pressure, c wind, d water, e land)
steps: This paper repeats all 35 tasks of the MESP Standard Five May 2024 paper, whose included script describes land-to-sea wind at night.
The reused questions make that script a strong candidate, but the teacher must confirm it; the title remains conditional.
questions.answer: No unique prescribed title can be confirmed because the listening script is absent. Conditional answer: c. Wind (Land Breeze), if the teacher uses the script printed in the matching MESP Standard Five May 2024 paper.

questions.prompt: A chairperson ___ in this office every month. (a work, b working, c works, d worked, e will work)
steps: A singular subject takes works for a present habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My father owns the car. It belongs to ___. (a him, b her, c their, d yours, e our)
steps: To takes the object pronoun him.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Opposite of heavy? (a heavier, b heaviest, c dark, d light, e noon)
steps: Light contrasts with heavy in weight.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Farida is among the students ___ received scholarships. (a whom, b which, c she, d whose, e who)
steps: Who is the subject relative pronoun for people.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The team ___ its matches in the 1900s challenge cup. (a won, b wins, c winning, d is winning, e win)
steps: A completed historical event uses past tense.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: How ___ girls are in class? (much, many)
steps: Girls is a plural count noun.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I was born ___ 1990. (on, in)
steps: Use in with a year.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His head is full of ___. (foolishiness, foolishness)
steps: This is the correctly spelled noun formed from foolish.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Our dog barks ___ at night. (loudly, roudly)
steps: Loudly is the correct adverb and spelling.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What ___ your brother doing now? (are, is)
steps: The singular brother takes is.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Match library with A medical treatment, B education, C read/borrow books, D milk sold, E minerals extracted.
steps: This is a library's function.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: C. A place to read and borrow books.

questions.prompt: Match mine.
steps: Mine here names an excavation, not a possessive pronoun.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: E. A place where minerals are extracted.

questions.prompt: Match hospital.
steps: A hospital provides care for sick people.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: A. A place for medical treatment.

questions.prompt: Match school.
steps: A school teaches pupils.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: B. A place for pupils' education.

questions.prompt: Match dairy.
steps: Dairy relates to milk and milk products.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: D. A place where milk is sold.

questions.prompt: Order with A-E: She asked them to wait.
steps: The nurse's request follows arrival and the explanation.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Order: Riziki was sick.
steps: Introduce the illness first.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Order: At hospital the nurse said the doctor was very busy.
steps: This follows travel to the hospital.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Order: His aunt took him to hospital.
steps: The illness prompts the hospital visit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Order: They waited on the bench for a long time.
steps: Waiting follows the nurse's instruction.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The director is ___ rewards. (provide)
steps: Is takes an ing verb; drop final e before ing.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: If my brother ___ early, he will board the bus. (wake up)
steps: Use present simple after if in this future condition.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Have Baba and Mama ___ to the teacher? (speak)
steps: Have requires the past participle spoken.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My children rarely ___ with toys. (play)
steps: The plural subject takes play for a habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He checked the tube by ___ it in water. (put)
steps: After by use ing; double t in putting.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who did Mrs. Kuti prepare food for?
steps: The opening sentence identifies the diners.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What does verandah mean?
steps: The guests sit in this sheltered outdoor part after eating.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: A covered, open porch or gallery alongside the outside of a house.

questions.prompt: Who congratulated the Kuti family?
steps: The final paragraph names the speaker.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Mr. Jembe, on behalf of the other guests.

questions.prompt: When did the party end?
steps: The final paragraph gives the ending time.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is the passage about?
steps: The congratulation indicates the occasion.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: A party celebrating the Kuti family's beautiful house.

summaries.Listening: Listen to the supplied teacher text and identify the exact detail asked for. Check spelling and sentence punctuation; missing scripts are explicitly identified.
summaries.Grammar and composition: Follow a clear sequence and keep the tense consistent. Introduce people and events before their pronouns, actions and final outcome.
summaries.Comprehension: Find evidence in the passage or poem before answering. Distinguish explicit statements, reasonable inferences and model interpretations.

Matching MESP Standard Five May 2024 paper, including land-breeze listening script

limitations: 1(v): Script is absent. Wind is a conditional answer based on an exact match of all 35 tasks to the MESP S5 May 2024 paper, not an invented prescribed transcript.
